content: Samson ọmaana Delila
Iwa ewu dani, Samson ofona ochina k'obhon kwa Gaza k'ẹkhọma cha Philistiya. Mada owobh kẹ, ọtza obhing k'ọzaaza-kwanọng wani m'erungiwu nduma.

Wa bẹ agbaak anọng pa Gaza bi, Samson owobh ma e. Mando kw'anọng pa Gaza afon atza ayeri ajinọng atzobha, bẹ ayima ka mbaakhamma s'obhon m'erungiwu nduma biphyir, atzik. Bẹ awobha bi sẹbh m'erungiwu nduma, am-aben ayok bi, “Mọ́fhẹ-ẹ da ewu ekk'ehobha.”

Yina, wa Samson oyima mẹ maa, opyiri k'orungittem. Obina m'orungittem ọtza ọbọkha mbaakhamma s'obhon mọgbakha mkpọmmachi mfa ọkhọbhi, okwu ọttara k'agbọkhọrọ ttara ekpo pya mbaakhamma biphyir. Otzini pyẹ ọnana ka mbabaang otzima ovura k'egbegbeho ebir-ebir, k'okhubha kw'okkeri Hẹbrọn itzitzikha.
K'ogbe mẹ, wa kwanọng wani kw'okpen Delila okwu ọdaak Samson k'Ittolim sa Sorẹk.

Wa adabhi p'anọng pa Philistiya atza akhebha kwanọng nwa aben-ẹ bi, “Bọhra Samson ifha ọgbaakh-ọ ndubhama kw'ẹfa chẹ, ifha mọfha ọnẹ-ẹ ẹfa, mobiro ọfha ọdabh-ẹ ndik, mokhem-ẹ. Ọnọng-ọnọng mottem kwaman, ọnang-ọ ashẹkẹl pa silva nnọhna mfa obhiri arọbh chi.”
Mando kwa Delila ọtza oben Samson bi, “Gbaakh-m ndubhama s'ẹfa chọ, ọmaana odem kw'ọnọng ọfha ọdabh-ọ ndik otzima okhem-ọ.”
Samson obhin-ẹ bi, “Idikha ọnọng manda wani otzim adik-naanga azenamfa p'agwu-ogwu ọdabh-m, kaam ẹfa ẹhaam-ọha mach'ẹha ojinọng kpenamkpen.”
Mẹ wọ ofon, wa adabhi p'anọng pa Philistiya achena kwanọng nwa adik-naanga azenamfa p'agwu-ogwu, otzima sẹ ọdabh-ẹ.

Ode ch'ajinọng akk'akwa achubha m'ẹmaanggọ. Kwanọng nwa oyer-ẹ, “Samson, anọng pa Philistiya an-abọkh-ọ e!” Mando kw'ọbọk adik-naanga mba ọkpaara bi pọhbh mach'edik-naanga eyon da ẹbaang ekpon. Iwa bẹ ndubhama s'ẹfa chẹ kafha aronga.
Iwa Delila oben Samson bi, “Akk'asa nger odidinginọng, akk'aam ibhora asa. Kọ gbaakh-m odem kw'ọnọng ọfha orenga ọdabh-ọ.”
Oben bi, “Idikha ọnọng otzim ndik mmasẹ sa bẹ anatzima am-atzima, kaam ẹfa ẹhaam-ọha mach'ẹha ojinọng kpenamkpen.”

Mando kwa Delila ọtzọk ndik mmasẹ otzima ọdabh-ẹ. Ode ch'ajinọng akk'akwa achubha m'ẹmaanggọ. Kwanọng nwa oyer-ẹ, “Samson, anọng pa Philistiya an-abọkh-ọ e!” Mando kw'ọbọk ndik sa bẹ adabh-ẹ ka mbọhk ọkpaara, mach'adik-naanga p'an-akkọri.

Iwa Delila oben Samson bi, “Kọ atzim am-asi-m nger odidinginọng o, akk'aam ibhora asa. Kọ gbaak-m odem kw'ọnọng ọfha orenga ọdabh-ọ.” Samson obhina bi, “Idikha atzọk akpadim mba p'eho chaam azenamfa, atzima edik-naanga abọkha bẹ abira atzima akpak atzobha bẹ, kaam ẹfa ẹhaam-ọha mach'ẹha ojinọng kpenamkpen.” Mẹ wọ ofon, mada Samson ọm-ọttaabha ọda, Delila ọtzọkha akpadim azenamfa p'eho cha Samson, ọbọkha bẹ
obiro otzima akpak otzobha bẹ. Mando kwobiro oyer-ẹ, “Samson, anọng pa Philistiya an-abọkh-ọ e!” Mando kw'ọphyọbh k'ọda, ọrọbha akpak obiro ọchaari edik-naanga ch'ẹbọk akpadim etzobha.

Mẹ wọ ofon, Delila oben-ẹ bi, “Ka yan kwa kọ aben bi, ‘Kaam ndaakh-ọ ọdaak,’ kw'an-akher ajaakhi ndubhama kwọ anang-m? On-ode igbe ittaan ma s'akk'asa nger odidinginọng, kakher ajaakhi ndubhama s'ẹfa chọ anang-m.”
Wa Samson e, ettem ebhem-ẹ itzama-itzama, okhuri odem kwa Delila oreng ọyaakh-ẹ atzim k'ewu kpenamkpen.

Ofona mẹ, wa ọgbaakh-ẹ odik kpenamkpen oben bi, “Ẹkpẹr kaam k'eho etzim ẹm-ẹttọhmi, kaam nde nnwa kwa bẹ atte ọbọhk ttẹwọr k'ibhọr anang Ibinọkpaabyi. Idikha bẹ aphyir-m isisaa, kaam ẹfa ẹhaam-ọha mach'ẹha ojinọng kpenamkpen.”

Mada Delila ore bi, Samson ọkk'ẹ odik kpenamkpen ọgbaakha, ọtzọhm ẹkkaabha ọnaang adabhi pa Philistiya oben bi, “Bọng na kpa nnam m'ogbe nwa; kkeri ọkk'aam odik kpenamkpen ọgbaakha.” Mando kw'adabhi pa Philistiya atzim silva ka mbọhk akwu.
Mada ọbọkh-ẹ ọttaabh-ẹ ma ndaak, Delila oyeri ọnọng okwu ophyiri Samson akpadim azenamfa pẹ, ọsi ẹfa ẹhẹ-ẹ.

Mẹ wọ ofon, kwanọng nwa oyer-ẹ, “Samson, anọng pa Philistiya an-abọkh-ọ e!” Mada ọphyọbh, ochibhi bi, “Tte nsi macha mminsi, mkpaara ndik sabẹ atzima adabh-m.” Yina, wa korong bi, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'ẹ ọbọhk ọtta.
Mando kw'anọng pa Philistiya abọkh-ẹ, arọbh-ẹ chen, atzim-ẹ achina k'obhon kwa Gaza. Wa bẹ agbaakh-ẹ ttara mgbakkọhbh sa brons, bẹ ahokh-ẹ bi, om-okhok ekpo k'ẹgbakkọhbh-ttọhmma.
Yina, wa isisaa sẹ s'eho ibiri ittẹwọr imen.
Obo kwa Samson

Iwa adabhi pa Philistiya atzobha bi, bẹ afọhni ẹja ọkkakka anang Dagọn kw'ode ọkha fabẹ, ttara bi, bẹ abira asi ọdadaami, bẹ aben bi, “Ọkha faman okk'Samson kw'ode ọttattaanga-nọng kwaman, ọtzọkha okhe man ka mbọhk.”
Mada anọng mba arẹ-ẹ, bẹ anang ọkha fabẹ ikpokpobha, aben bi,

content.text: okk'ọttattaanga-nọng kwaman ọtzọkha okhe man ka mbọhk,

content: Mada bẹ am-asi ọdadaami, bẹ aben bi, “Bọng dima Samson ayin ka, okwu osi mọmma aha.” Wa bẹ ayeri Samson k'ẹgbakkọhbh-ttọhmma oyin ka, okwu osi bẹ amma aha. Mada bẹ abẹ-ẹ k'ottem kwa mkpọmmachi.
Wa Samson oben ọtzọhmnọng kw'ọbọkh-ẹ bi, “Tte mbe k'ibe sa mfha mbọkha mbọhk ka mkpọmmachi sa mbọk ọhọhm nwa, ifha mphe mẹ.”

Wa anọng afu m'ọhọhm nwa bi pyẹr, ajinọng ọmaana panọng; wa adabhi pa Philistiya abira awobha mẹ, anọng nnọhna nzenamfa obhiri arọbh jobh ajinọng ọmaana panọng, awobha k'ẹnyọhng am-are idik sa Samson om-osi.

Mẹ wọ ofon, wa Samson ozi njọhm oyeri Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, oben bi, “O Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'Ọyọhng, jim-m e. Tzotzokhaan, Ibinọkpaabyi nang-m ẹfa ogbe nwa wani dokh e, ndima ẹbọhk-duk dani ndima ndukha chen paam afa p'anọng mba pa Philistiya arọbh.”
Mando kwa Samson ọbọk mbọhk ka mkpọmmachi mfa sa mbọk ọhọhm nwa k'ottem. Ọbọkha odimbọhk k'ẹkpọmmachi dani, obiro otzima kwabọhk ọbọkha ndonggo.

Samson oben bi, “Tte kaam mpe ttara anọng mba pa Philistiya!” Mẹ wọ ofon, Samson otzima ẹfa chẹ biphyir onyuni mkpọmmachi nna maa, wa ọhọhm otto ọkpẹkhi adabhi pa Philistiya ọmaana anọng biphyir p'awobh k'ọhọhm nwa k'ẹtzaanga. Wa anọng p'ofhu k'ogbe kw'ope, an-anyọhnga anọng p'ofhu da orukhi akpen.

Iwa agbaanatte pẹ, ọmaana ẹhọhmmọr ch'otte biphyir afona bi, atza atzọkh-ẹ. Bẹ atzim-ẹ akpa nnam atza anọhnga k'ottem kwa Zora ọmaana Ẹshtaol k'epekhubh ch'otte Manoa. Kẹ wa ode osi-aponga k'Israẹl ka cho ẹrọbh.
